options.name: account_id
options.description:
Account ID of the API keys(s) to query.
If a service IAM ID is specified in iam_id then account_id must match the account of the IAM ID.
If a user IAM ID is specified in iam_id then then account_id must match the account of the Authorization token.

options.name: hide_public_access
options.description: If hide_public_access is true, do not include the Public Access Group in the results.

options.name: iam_id
options.description: Return groups for member ID (IBMid, service ID or trusted profile ID).

options.name: limit
options.description: Return up to this limit of results where limit is between 0 and 100.

options.name: offset
options.description: The offset of the first result item to be returned.

options.name: show_federated
options.description: If show_federated is true, each group listed will return an is_federated value that is set to true if rules exist for the group.

options.name: sort
options.description: Sort the results by id, name, description, or is_federated flag.

options.name: transaction_id
options.description:
An optional transaction ID can be passed to your request, which can be useful for tracking calls through multiple services by using one identifier.
The header key must be set to Transaction-Id and the value is anything that you choose.
If no transaction ID is passed in, then a random ID is generated.
